## Focus a single line

````markdown
```{.r data-code-line-style="focus:3" data-code-line-style-preset="emphasis"}
df |>
  ...
```
````

```{.r data-code-line-style="focus:3" data-code-line-style-preset="emphasis"}
df |>
  filter(cyl == 6) |>
  group_by(gear) |>
  summarise(m = mean(mpg)) |>
  arrange(desc(m))
```

## Dim everything except the focus

````markdown
```{.r data-code-line-style="dim:1-2,focus:3,dim:4-5"
        data-code-line-style-preset="emphasis"}
```
````

```{.r data-code-line-style="dim:1-2,focus:3,dim:4-5" data-code-line-style-preset="emphasis"}
df |>
  filter(cyl == 6) |>
  group_by(gear) |>
  summarise(m = mean(mpg)) |>
  arrange(desc(m))
```

## Strong call-out

```{.r data-code-line-style="strong:3" data-code-line-style-preset="emphasis"}
df |>
  filter(cyl == 6) |>
  group_by(gear) |>
  summarise(m = mean(mpg)) |>
  arrange(desc(m))
```

## YAML form with preset selection

````markdown
```{{r}}
#| code-line-style:
#|   preset: emphasis
#|   steps:
#|     - { dim: 1-2 }
#|     - { focus: 3, dim: [1-2, 4-5] }
#|     - { strong: 3, dim: [1-2, 4-5] }
```
````

```{r}
#| echo: true
#| eval: false
#| code-line-style:
#|   preset: emphasis
#|   steps:
#|     - { dim: 1-2 }
#|     - { focus: 3, dim: [1-2, 4-5] }
#|     - { strong: 3, dim: [1-2, 4-5] }
mtcars |>
  dplyr::filter(cyl == 6) |>
  dplyr::group_by(gear) |>
  dplyr::summarise(m = mean(mpg)) |>
  dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(m))
```
